(c)).
This observation clearly signals the rigidity
of the long-range spatiotemporal order emerging in
the observed programmable time-crystal phases. We
also measured the condensate speed ωm for differ-
ent packing orders m as a function of 1/L, see
Fig. 4.(e), finding a remarkable agreement with the
hydrodynamic predictions in the large system size
limit L →∞.

acterizing the universality class of the observed
phase transitions to these programmable time-
crystal phases, we performed extensive measure-
ments around the critical region in our Monte Carlo
simulations.
